task.problem: RUN-233-002 classified the workers=12 failure set as MIXED. Exactly one target, tests/test_git_fixture_isolation.py::test_depth_amplified_sandboxes_push_and_resolve_full_aios_refs, was absent from the serial reproduction set but reproduced at n4 and n12. Its durable failure was a CalledProcessError at the real Git push on line 254 with return code 1, while the prior diagnostic retained only the generic sanitized stderr excerpt "repository-error". The test deliberately exercises full 64-hex AIOS refs whose remote lock path exceeds 260 characters. Later TASK-237 through TASK-239 corrected the independent stable failures but did not diagnose or change this parallel-only fixture path. Choosing a path, fixture, Git, host, Defender, or concurrency fix from the current evidence would therefore be guesswork.
